detection_rule: payment_status == Paid AND net_amount == standard_fee AND continue_same_batch == Yes AND active_students_count < max_batch_size AND payer_contact == student_contact
automated_action: Generate booking_request (status=Completed); generate class_schedule_bookings for next term; decrement batch capacity
parent_notification: WhatsApp Template W1: Class Renewal Confirmed & Calendar Schedule Added
teacher_notification: WhatsApp/Slack Alert T1: Student renewed in your batch; view schedule in portal

detection_rule: invoices.payment_status == Paid AND paid_at < NOW() - 2 hours AND NOT EXISTS in faculty_form_unapproved
automated_action: Auto-fetch student profile from reference table; initiate renewal; ping teacher with one-tap confirmation
human_intervention_required: Yes (if teacher does not click 1-tap confirm in 2h)
parent_notification: WhatsApp Template W2: Payment received! We are setting up your schedule; confirmation shortly
teacher_notification: WhatsApp Alert T2: Parent of {student_name} paid renewal. Confirm continuing batch with 1-click

automated_action: Perform secondary fuzzy lookup on user_id; if matched, route to Ops exception queue with payer vs registered comparison
human_intervention_required: Yes (1-click link confirmation in Ops portal)
parent_notification: WhatsApp Template W3: Renewal payment received from {payer_phone}. Please confirm child name

detection_rule: invoices.payment_status == Partially_Paid OR invoices.net_amount < standard_fee_24_sessions_inr (without scholarship flag)
automated_action: Hold class scheduling; calculate remaining balance; generate dynamic payment link for remaining tranche
parent_notification: WhatsApp Template W4: Partial payment of INR {net_amount} received. Click here to complete remaining INR {balance}
teacher_notification: WhatsApp Alert T3: Partial payment noted for {student_name}. Full schedule activates upon completion

detection_rule: invoices.payment_status == Failed OR (faculty_form submitted AND gateway_order_id NOT SETTLED)
automated_action: Reject unverified submission; block scheduling; log fraud/error alert; generate fresh payment link
parent_notification: WhatsApp Template W5: Payment for {student_name} did not go through. Click here to retry securely
teacher_notification: WhatsApp Alert T4: UPI payment for {student_name} was unsuccessful at bank. Do not start classes yet

automated_action: Fuzzy match on (faculty_form.student_id == invoices.student_id AND payment_status == Paid); auto-correct if unique single match
human_intervention_required: No if single student match; Yes if ambiguous
teacher_notification: WhatsApp Alert T5: Invoice ID corrected from {typed_id} to {real_id}. No action needed

automated_action: Retain first valid submission; flag subsequent rows as DUPLICATE_SUPPRESSED; do not create duplicate booking request
teacher_notification: WhatsApp Alert T6: Duplicate submission detected and merged. No duplicate booking created

automated_action: Flag as BATCH_FULL; query database for sister batches at same grade/subject; draft batch options for Ops review
parent_notification: WhatsApp Template W6: {student_name} batch is at maximum size. Here are 2 sister batches with open slots
teacher_notification: WhatsApp Alert T7: Your batch is full (6/6). {student_name} will be assigned to sister batch or capacity expanded

automated_action: Hold booking_request in Awaiting_Parent_Batch_Selection; dispatch interactive WhatsApp slot picker widget to parent
human_intervention_required: No if parent picks slot via WhatsApp; Yes if no selection in 12h
parent_notification: WhatsApp Template W7 (Interactive): Tap below to select your child new class days and preferred time
teacher_notification: WhatsApp Alert T8: {student_name} requested time change. Next batch details will update once selected

detection_rule: invoices.discount_amount > 0 OR faculty_form.remarks ILIKE "%scholarship%" OR faculty_form.remarks ILIKE "%discount%"
automated_action: Check discount <= 20% against student retention history; route to Slack #ops-approvals with 1-click Approve/Reject buttons
parent_notification: WhatsApp Template W8: Special scholarship fee received. Your classes are being finalized
teacher_notification: Slack Notification: 20% discount submitted for {student_name}. Awaiting Ops Lead sign-off
